page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The server is configured with 8 vCPUs derived from 4 dedicated physical cores with 2 threads per core, alongside 32.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Cache resources include 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a 35 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA. Hardware virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor. Baseline network bandwidth is provisioned at 2 Gbps, while local disk storage is not bundled, requiring external block storage for persistent data. The instance includes no discrete graphics processors or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results reflect the legacy profile of the Broadwell-era architecture. PassMark CPU testing measures 7032.02 points, representing average throughput, with extended instruction handling reaching 6072.66 points. Single-threaded metrics, however, show lower performance, evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 928.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 1100.18, placing them in the lower quartile. Geekbench multi-core registers at 3534.0, while stress-ng multi-core reaches 5879.59. Memory throughput remains steady under large sequential loads, achieving 40.42 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads and 35.62 GB/sec for writes, though small cached read bandwidth registers in the bottom quartile at 328.17 GB/sec. Compression performance is modest, with single-threaded gzip achieving 19.11 GB/sec and single-threaded bzip3 decompression recording 7.46 GB/sec.

With balanced CPU and memory allocation, the ecs.sn2ne.2xlarge is suited for standard enterprise background tasks, web serving, basic Redis caching, and non-critical batch processing. Its modest compute scores indicate lower efficiency for CPU-intensive compilation, ray tracing, or heavy machine learning tasks compared to newer generation hardware classes.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the x86_64 architecture and KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, delivering 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system includes 32.0 GB of RAM, maintaining an even 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio, supported by a 35 MB L3 cache. The instance does not include integrated local storage or discrete GPU accelerators, relying on remote block storage and 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark evaluations place CPU and memory throughput in the lower-to-average brackets, characterized by an overall PassMark CPU score of 7032.02 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 3534.0. Large-block memory transfers achieve 40.42 GB/sec for uncached reads. This hardware profile functions effectively for general enterprise services, medium-traffic web servers, and distributed caching where compute intensity remains moderate.
